citations.quote: Unsere Tochter (5) hat Asthma, und seit dem Frühling hat sie viel häufiger Anfälle, zweimal mussten wir nachts in den Notfall.
Wir haben in der ganzen Wohnung Schimmel: An den Aussenwänden läuft Kondenswasser herunter, und an den Fensterrahmen bildet sich schwarzer Schimmel, im Kinderzimmer am schlimmsten.
Dazu kommt, dass der Heizkessel nachts ausgeht, sodass die Schlafzimmer am Morgen kalt sind.
Ich bitte Sie, sich die Wohnung anzusehen und die notwendigen Arbeiten in Auftrag zu geben.

plan.because: Needed to establish the parties, property and tenancy terms.
The May letter does not identify the defects reported. Request any notice or other record showing what was reported and when.
Evidence of whether and when the landlord received the defect report is missing.
Dated images of the affected locations and visible defects are needed.
The reported response, any proposed work and access arrangements need documentation.
Mould is reported; dated moisture and temperature observations are needed.
A heating fault is reported; request any inspection and service findings.
Health effects are reported. Obtain documented findings and the limits of any attributed cause; the reported cause is not independently established.
A need for a specialist is not mentioned and is presumed absent for planning under the silence policy. The technical cause remains open.
A rent deposit is not mentioned and is presumed not considered for planning.
This document is optional under the process.

questions: Is the child currently experiencing symptoms or another urgent health risk? Seek urgent medical advice or emergency care if needed.
When did the defects begin, and which rooms and locations are affected?
Do you have evidence of the landlord receiving the May letter, records of the calls, or another notice identifying the mould and heating fault?
Has any inspection or heating service taken place, and has the landlord proposed work or requested access?
